presence_grain_definition.key: casefold -> collapse whitespace -> strip trailing possessive ('s / ’s / trailing apostrophe) -> strip leading honorific tokens repeatedly (token compared with trailing '.' removed); if nothing would remain, keep the un-stripped form
presence_grain_definition.what: per document: scorer relaxed match at mention level, then collapse mentions to a normalised surface key; a gold KEY is found if any of its mentions matched; a predicted KEY is false if none of its mentions matched. P = true predicted keys / predicted keys; R = found gold keys / gold keys; both summed over (document, key) pairs, which is what person_mentions stores.
